title: Custom Office & Business Furniture | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Custom furniture for offices, receptions, meeting rooms and executive offices. Design, production and installation in Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Custom furniture for offices, stores, and salons in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Custom furniture for offices, stores, and salons in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: We design and build custom furniture for commercial spaces in Bratislava and Vienna: offices, stores, boutiques, beauty salons, and showrooms. Everything is made at our own production facility in Bratislava, and our own team delivers and installs it. Prices are the same for both cities, and delivery is included.

You can order a single piece, such as a reception desk, or all the furniture for the space together with the interior design. We set the dimensions, construction, and interior fittings based on site measurements and on how the space is actually used.

Reception desks, executive office furniture, employee workstations, conference tables, filing cabinets, office kitchens, lounge furniture, wall panels. In a 140 m² office, the front of the reception desk was clad in translucent stone lit from within. Filing cabinets with tinted glass doors went into every office, so all the furniture reads as one set.

Display cases, shelving, checkout areas, fitting rooms, storage systems. We plan retail furniture around the specific merchandise: what goes on display and what is kept in closed cabinets as backstock. In a 50 m² store, the front panel of the checkout counter is perforated black metal with the store’s name, and behind the counter a wall-to-wall wooden shelving unit holds boxes of stock.
Reception desks, stylist and technician workstations, cabinets for supplies, waiting area furniture. For work areas, we use surfaces that stand up to frequent wet cleaning.

For every piece, we prepare working drawings and a specification: dimensions, construction, materials, hardware, interior fittings. Production works from these drawings, so the finished furniture matches the design.

Fronts — laminated chipboard, foil-wrapped or painted MDF, veneer, HPL, acrylic, glass; hardware — Hettich, Blum, Häfele. For desks and counters used all day long, we recommend hard-wearing HPL or compact laminate.

Furniture can carry your company’s colors, materials, and graphics. In a 500 m² office, the reception desk and workstations were made in the same terracotta as the walls, and the wall behind the desk was clad in backlit slats with a 3D logo.

items: Inquiry. Send us a floor plan of the space, photos, and your brand book if you have one. We reply within one business day, and the consultation is free.
Site measurement. We come to the site in Bratislava or Vienna.
Quote. The cost of the pieces, including delivery and installation, as one total. We give the production lead time at the same stage.
Production and installation. We make the furniture in Bratislava, then deliver and install it with our own team.

parts.html: We price the work from the drawings: the cost depends on the number and size of the pieces, the materials, and the hardware. If you need furniture designed for the whole space, the “Furniture” package is the convenient option: €35–50/m², minimum €2,000. For an 80 m² office, that comes to €2,800–4,000 for 3D visualization and a full set of furniture drawings; production and installation are priced separately, based on those drawings.

items.q: Can I order just a reception desk or a single table?
items.a: Yes. We design a single piece from site measurements, show it in a 3D visualization, and make it. If you need more furniture later, we will make it in the same materials and colors.

items.q: Do I need an interior design project for the whole space?
items.a: If the layout, lighting, and finishes stay as they are, a furniture design is enough. If the whole space is changing, it is better to start with commercial interior design: then outlets, lighting, and connection points for the furniture are planned in advance, and nothing has to be redone.
It depends on the size of the order, the materials, and how busy production is. We give the lead time with the quote; it runs from approval of the design and the advance payment.

items.q: Do you make furniture for companies in Vienna?
items.a: Yes. Our team does the measurement and installation, we make the furniture in Bratislava, delivery is included, and prices are the same as in Bratislava. We also deliver and install furniture throughout Slovakia and in Germany.

items.q: Where can I see the materials before ordering?
items.a: At the studio at Súkennícka 1 in Bratislava, by appointment. We have samples of fronts, countertops, and hardware there, so you can compare them in person before approving the design.
